diagram internals(root: block, depth: int = 1):
    let blocks = root.descendants(depth)
    show root
    show root.ports
    show blocks
    show flow between (root union blocks)
diagram requirement_tree(root: requirement, depth: int = 3):\n    show root\n    show root.descendants(depth)

diagram satisfaction(root: requirement):
    show root
    show root.sources(satisfies)
    show satisfies to root

check requirement_satisfied (warning):
    for each r in requirement where children is empty:
        require r.sources(satisfies) is not empty
        otherwise "Requirement {r} is not satisfied by any block."
